body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Earnest living chess pawn, deeply invested in every piece doing its job. Sincere and almost heroic, without military commands. Voice direction: Ringing female alto speaking English with a French accent. Clear forward tone, nimble phrasing and proud attention to each piece doing its job. Warm energetic sincerity rather than authority or swagger. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Every piece has a job! That one was protecting its neighbor. Moving away leaves the other piece exposed. Check its job before it goes.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
